 Property Guru, FMT Text Size: Dark Mode: Off Text: Dark Mode: Off 51% of survey respondents say they do not qualify for government affordable-housing schemes and cannot buy property without financial help. Kuala Lumpur: Issues of affordability continue to loom over potential home buyers, with 51% of survey respondents indicating they do not qualify for government affordable-housing schemes, and are unable to purchase property without financial help.
